prose.text: The block runs the formatter and linter, the agent crate's unit suite, the root unit layer, the changed integration binaries by name (`cli_verify` among them: the fake's trust reading changes), the whole integration and E2E layers (the stamping helpers, the harness boot and the rig rehearsals reach every stamped binary), the schema and bounded-reader contracts, the release check (the fake agent changed), the live round (S1, S2) and the operator pass. Every root test that waits keeps the shared 12 s `WITHIN` under the 20 s lint; the rig rehearsal of `TS` drives a verify and sits where the `V` rehearsal sits, its kill the one that binary already has. The harness boot is not a touchpoint and no boot-path file changes beyond the start (`src/cmd/run.rs` is exercised by every booted case), so the operator pass boots one session `trust-smoke` as the last chunk did and reads it. No mutation run (directive item 7).

The remove-the-guard controls are implement's one-shot `gate.py control` runs, not entries (validation.md check 4 (6)), each fired with `--timeout 900` (sized to the integration entry's build plus its named cases, each case bounded by `WITHIN`), each control's entry named; «holds» means each named case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line: - `trust-nocall` — `src/cmd/run.rs`: the start's trust call removed (no file read, no line); entry: the named   integration entry; case `run_in_an_untrusted_folder_writes_the_record_and_types_no_key`. With the guard gone the   subject starts its child in the untrusted folder, the fake draws the trust form and fires no SessionStart; the case's   wait for it ends at `WITHIN` — unmeasured until this control runs. - `trust-gate` — `src/cmd/run.rs`: the `cli_verified` arm removed (the write made on an unverified CLI); entry: the   named integration entry; case `run_on_an_unverified_home_writes_nothing`. With the guard gone the record is written on   an unverified home — unmeasured until this control runs. - `trust-walk` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/trust.rs`: the walk cut to the exact key; entry: `cargo nextest run -p   viola-agent-claude`; case `trust_walk_reads_the_exact_key_then_each_parent`. With the guard gone a subfolder of a   trusted parent is written a needless record — unmeasured until this control runs. - `trust-flagonly` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/trust.rs`: the flag-only set replaced by a whole-entry insert;   entry: `cargo nextest run -p viola-agent-claude`; case `flag_only_set_keeps_every_other_key`. With the guard gone an   existing entry's other keys are lost — unmeasured. - `trust-exact` — `src/trust_record.rs`: the read-back cut to the flag alone; entry: `bash scripts/agent-run.sh run   --unit`; case `trust_start_read_back_with_an_added_key_is_lost`. With the guard gone a raced entry reads `written` —   unmeasured. - `trust-home` — `src/trust_record.rs`: the home-folder rule removed; entry: `bash scripts/agent-run.sh run --unit`;   case `trust_start_home_folder_opens_nothing`. With the guard gone the home folder is written a record — unmeasured. Each id is at most 16 characters; a `timeout` reading is not «holds».
